Exercises.title: Practice exercise set
Exercises.intro: Dynamic, guidance activities to work with children. These are template exercises (not official Leeduca content).

generator.title: Create exercises by theme
generator.subtitle: Choose a theme and generate tailored examples to practice right away.
generator.themePlaceholder: E.g. farm animals, winter, the shop, the human body
generator.focusPlaceholder: E.g. rhymes, initial syllables, counting objects, ordering sequences
generator.notesPlaceholder: E.g. use everyday vocabulary, include animal images, avoid difficult words
generator.hint: Generation uses AI and may take a few seconds. Review content before using it with children.

errors.themeRequired: Enter a theme to generate exercises.
errors.notConfigured: AI generation is not configured. Add an AI key (e.g. GROQ_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY) to the environment variables.
errors.invalidInput: Check the theme and selected options.
errors.timeout: Generation took too long. Please try again.
errors.unauthorized: The AI key is invalid or lacks permissions. Check GROQ_API_KEY/OPENAI_API_KEY in .env.local and restart the server.
errors.rateLimit: The AI provider rate limit was reached. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.badRequest: The AI provider rejected the request (invalid model or payload). Check GROQ_MODEL/OPENAI_MODEL or try another model and restart.
errors.requestFailed: The AI provider returned an error. Please try again shortly.
errors.invalidResponse: Could not generate valid exercises. Try another theme, reduce the count, or try again.
errors.generic: Could not generate exercises. Check the server terminal (npm run dev) for details and try again.

Home.heroTitle: School platform for oral language, reading, and early difficulty prevention
Home.heroSubtitle: MVP template to explore a Leeduca-like web structure: screening, assessment, intervention, and follow-up in an educational setting.
Home.cardScreeningBody: Early detection and monitoring with individual and group tests by age.
Home.cardInterventionBody: Pathways such as Preleo and Leetrea to build and strengthen reading skills.
Home.cardResourcesBody: Materials, publications, and support for schools, teachers, and families.

PublicLayout.tagline: Intervention, screening, and monitoring of oral language and reading.
PublicLayout.footerNote: Demonstration template without real content or operational link to the original platform.

whatIs.title: What is Leeduca
whatIs.intro: Leeduca is a project focused on preventing and addressing oral language and reading difficulties in schools through assessment, intervention, and monitoring.

sections.purposeBody: Support early detection and evidence-based educational response.
sections.schoolBody: Tools designed for use in schools and coordination with professionals.
sections.monitorBody: Track progress to adjust supports and intervention programs.

oralLanguage.title: Oral language and reading
oralLanguage.intro: Oral language development is the foundation of reading. This section would present fundamentals, warning signs, and preventive work lines.

blocks.oralBody: Phonological awareness, vocabulary, comprehension, and expression.
blocks.readingBody: Decoding, fluency, reading comprehension, and writing.
blocks.supportBody: Guidance for early intervention and school-family coordination.

intervention.title: Intervention programs
intervention.intro: Space to describe stimulation and intervention programs. The MVP includes access to Preleo and Leetrea.

programs.preleoBody: Oral language stimulation: universal program, intensification, review, and palette.
programs.leetreaBody: Reading learning and consolidation with structured pathways.

screening.title: Screening and reports
screening.intro: Area for early detection, assessment batteries, and follow-up reports to support educational decisions.

items.individualBody: Individual application by age (3 to 8 years in the observed demo).
items.collectiveBody: Group application by age (6 to 11 years in the observed demo).
items.reportsBody: Results, risk profiles, and progress (pending real data).
